bio.text: Phara Souffrant Forrest represents the 57th Assembly District in Brooklyn, which includes Fort Greene, Clinton Hill and parts of Bedford-Stuyvesant and Crown Heights; she was first elected in 2020.
Before holding office she worked as a maternal child field nurse and was president of her building's tenant association.
She attended SUNY Geneseo, then earned an associate's nursing degree at CUNY City Tech and a BSN at the CUNY School of Professional Studies.
She is a lifelong resident of the district and lives in Crown Heights.
